'''Trims''' decorate armor as in vanilla, but the color comes from a [[Smithing Trim Color|smithing trim color]] instead of an ingot or gem. Trims work on the pack's custom armor too.

{| class="wikitable"
! Color !! Center ingredient !! Material shown
|-
| Amethyst || block of amethyst || Amethyst
|-
| Cinnabar || cinnabar || Cinnabar (redstone)
|-
| Diamond || block of diamond || Diamond
|-
| Electrum || electrum alloy || Electrum
|-
| Gold || block of gold || Gold
|-
| Hepatizon || hepatizon alloy || Hepatizon
|-
| Iron || block of iron || Iron (the netherite material)
|-
| Lapis || block of lapis lazuli || Lapis
|-
| Patina || oxidized copper || Patina (emerald)
|-
| Quartz || block of quartz || Quartz
|-
| Resin || block of resin || Resin
|-
| Shakudo || shakudo alloy || Shakudo
|-
| Steel || steel alloy || Steel (the iron material)
|}
Shakudo, hepatizon and electrum have their own trim materials, with darker variants on armor of the same alloy.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/trim_material/shakudo.json}}</ref> A silver material name exists in the language file but has no recipe. Most trim templates keep their vanilla duplication recipes.
